world_articles.title: The Aether Accord
world_articles.summary: The treaty that limits memory magic across the Seven Houses.
world_articles.body: The Accord forbids binding a living memory without a witness. [[House Veyra]] guards the original seal.

world_articles.title: Festival of Returning Lanterns
world_articles.summary: A river rite marking the end of the long winter.
world_articles.body: Each lantern carries the name of one person who did not return.

world_articles.title: Whisperglass
world_articles.summary: A mineral that stores the last sentence spoken near it.
world_articles.body: Mining is controlled by the Cartographers' Guild.

persons.biography: Archivist of forbidden memories and reluctant heir to House Veyra.
persons.notes: Keeps a shard of whisperglass hidden in her sleeve.

world_rules.title: Every bound memory needs a witness
world_rules.title_key: every bound memory needs a witness
world_rules.statement: No living memory may be sealed without a second person who can name its source.
world_rules.cost: The witness permanently loses one detail of the event.
world_rules.limits: A witness cannot attest their own memory.

world_rules.title: Whisperglass must be paid
world_rules.statement: Listening twice to the same shard has a price.

world_questions.question: Who broke the original seal on the Accord?
Does the moving border follow water or memory?

world_scene_text.text: At dawn the flooded gate rose one black iron tooth at a time. Lyra waited until the bells stopped before stepping into the archive she had sworn never to enter again.
Orren laid three maps on the table. Each was correct. None described the same country.
Smoke moved through the lower stacks like a reader searching for one forbidden name.
